parse.text:
Koda: Sink With Thee

Char­ac­ter

Vodyanitsa

Talent Type

Elemental Burst

Category

Combat
Energy Cost Cool­down
60 15s
  • Info
Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals AoE Hydro DMG to the opponent.
When in the Song of Ages PastRechitativ: Sonorous DawnReveals her true Water Imp form, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and gaining theSong of Ages Past effect: While this effect is active, Vodyanitsa summons the ancientHorn of Spring's Call, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing Hydro DMG.
The above two types of attacks will also decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of opponents hit. Additionally, while theSong of Ages Past effect is active, the party's active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP. state, DMG dealt is further increased.

"According to legend, the song of the Water Imps can lead sailors to their ruin. But if everyone was lost to the water, where did this story come from?"
"It's probably from a Domovoy sailor who was too short to go over the ship's railing, heh... Stop giving me that look, Odette! I was just joking!"

Koda: Sink With Thee is Vodyanitsa's Elemental Burst.
